      MONITORING AND OBSERVABILITY

      SolarWinds Observability is a full-stack, AI-powered solution that offers two deployment options: Self-hosted and SaaS. With the continued expansion of network and infrastructure capabilities in the SaaS option and the continued expansion of cloud capabilities in the self-hosted option, both offerings can provide end-to-end hybrid visibility. They also include overlapping capabilities and interconnectivity, giving IT teams and the organizations they support the flexibility to observe complex environments however they want.

KCT NG release history

This topic applies to KCT NG 2026.2 and later. If you are on KCT 3.12.7 or earlier, see legacy topic.

Current version: 2026.2.1

See the End of Life Policy for information about SolarWinds product life cycle phases.

Supported versions with end-of-life announcement

Version EoL announcement EoE effective date EoL effective date
KCT 3.12.5 April 21, 2026: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement – Customers on KCT 3.12.5 should begin transitioning to the latest version of KCT NG. July 21, 2026: End-of-Engineering (EoE) – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for KCT 3.12.5 will no longer be actively supported by SolarWinds. July 21, 2027: End-of-Life (EoL) – SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for KCT 3.12.5.
KCT 3.12.4 October 21, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement – Customers on KCT 3.12.4 should begin transitioning to the latest version of KCT NG. July 15, 2026: End-of-Engineering (EoE) – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for KCT 3.12.4 will no longer be actively supported by SolarWinds. July 15, 2027: End-of-Life (EoL) – SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for KCT 3.12.4.
KCT 3.12.3 April 15, 2025: End-of-Life (EoL) announcement – Customers on KCT NG 3.12.3 should begin transitioning to the latest version of KCT NG. July 15, 2026: End-of-Engineering (EoE) – Service releases, bug fixes, workarounds, and service packs for KCT NG 3.12.3 will no longer be actively supported by SolarWinds. July 15, 2027: End-of-Life (EoL) – SolarWinds will no longer provide technical support for KCT NG 3.12.3.
